_note: Supplier-tier structure of a value chain: how deep the supply chain runs behind the finished product. The tiers run the opposite way to the value-chain stages - Tier 1 are the direct suppliers of the sports goods manufacturer (the finished-goods specialists and the branded inputs they sell), Tier 2 supply Tier 1, Tier 3 source the basic materials and commodities Tier 2 works with. The tier levels, descriptions and example supplier types are taken from the sports goods study's supply-chain structure table; the items are the Atlas's own HS-coded grounding of each tier, mapped to the Atlas product mapping (the ministry shown is always the Atlas's mapping, never a second opinion). Codes must exist in the GST HSN master and in HS 2022; the loader rejects anything else.
